subquestion: Q1 of research/asr-mechanism-positioning-2026-10-15: is the ASR jump an acceleration of the continuous margin itself, and how much of the ASR steepness is flip-point synchrony versus common-course acceleration
why_not_saved_states: mothers logged only hit counts and 4 sensor margins; the 2-step adapters cover [t_fork, t_jump+20] only, which contains the r2-style window for s1107 alone; s1106's recorded t_jump = 72 is a false start (hits 4-13 until 92, the rise is 93 -> 100)

materials.replay: frozen trainer from update 0 for 160 updates, mother's own order; adapter sha256 at every update must equal the mother's recorded hash

readout.kernel: measurement_kernels.run_path path B (single forward, no generation), isolated RNG
per_row: margin = logit(target first token) - logit(gold first token)

window_primary.rule: b = first update with ASR60 >= high; a = last update before b with ASR60 <= low; pre-window p = a - (b - a)

analysis.gate: agreement between hit and margin > 0 over [p, b] >= 0.90, else unmeasurable
analysis.d1: additive model R2 and D statistic with 10000 bootstraps (descriptive)
analysis.d2: common course c(t) = row mean; v_pre over [p, a], v_in over [a, b]; accel_ratio = v_in / v_pre (inf if v_pre <= 0); W = 5-95% width of flip points; steps needed at each speed
analysis.d3: share of rows whose own slope inside the window exceeds 1.5 x their own pre-window slope
analysis.threshold_sweep: tau in -8..8 step 2; width of the primary window on ASR_tau; equal widths for |tau| <= 4 (within 2x of tau = 0) is the constant-speed signature (descriptive)
analysis.breakpoint: BIC of linear / quadratic / one-breakpoint piecewise-linear fits of c(t) on [0, min(160, b+20)] (descriptive)
analysis.crosscheck: argmax hits vs the mother's generation-based oracle hits per update
analysis.byproduct_not_analysed: clean-condition margins and correct counts per update (material for Q3)

classes.real: gate passed and accel_ratio >= 3 and d3 >= 0.8
classes.artifact: gate passed and accel_ratio < 1.5 and d3 < 0.5

preregistered_prediction.basis: r2: accel ratio 4-18 and D3 87-100% on LLaVA s1/s2 and Qwen s1; s1106's shoulder (65-88) is the hardest case

stop_loss.not_bit_exact: engineering failure; fix and rerun; never analyse non-exact data
stop_loss.threshold_artifact: Q1 fails; the paper's premise must be rewritten; stop and discuss
stop_loss.mixed: report per mother; only real mothers enter Q3

scope_limits: one model, one dose, one trigger, three mothers
all quantities defined on the first token of V60
clean by-product not interpreted in this step

budget.reference_estimate_not_cap: 15-18 min per mother, about 50 GPU minutes in total
